shell.tagline: Promoters Of the Word Empowering Reality

hero.title: Experience the POWER of Prayer
hero.powerMeaning: Promoters Of the Word Empowering Reality
hero.introAfter: We are a community of Christians, largely of Haitian heritage, committed to ongoing spiritual growth through love, daily prayer, and the Bible study.
hero.volunteer: Volunteer to lead or speak on the line

vision.intro: We see a family of believers who are:

growing.title: GROWING
growing.body: In Christ through love, daily prayer, and Bible study.

promoting.title: PROMOTING
promoting.body: The word of God that has the ability to transform lives.

supporting.title: SUPPORTING
supporting.body: One another spiritually, emotionally, and even financially.

involved.title: Get Involved
involved.lead: If you are genuinely seeking spiritual growth, then you are in great company!
involved.body: Our members share this goal, and it is what keeps us going. We seek to glorify God by ardently studying His Word, striving daily to follow in the footsteps of Jesus Christ, and sharing His message within the communities we serve.

thankYou.title: Thank You!
thankYou.intro: Your message has been received. We truly appreciate you taking the time to reach out and connect with the POWER Prayer Line family.
thankYou.heading: We’re grateful for you
thankYou.body: Whether this was a prayer request, a question, or a willingness to serve, please know that your submission matters to us. Someone from the ministry will follow up as soon as possible.
thankYou.badge: You are part of the POWER family

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.introBefore: We are opened to your comments and/or suggestions. Let us know how we can improve below. If you would like to lead the prayer line or deliver a message to us,

placeholders.subject: How can we help?
placeholders.message: Write your message or prayer request...

flyer.title: Share the Prayer Line
flyer.description: Help us spread the word. You can view and download the POWER Prayer Line flyer below and share it with family, friends, or your church community.
flyer.tip: Tip: On mobile, long-press the image to save it directly to your phone and share it via text or social media.

volunteer.title: Volunteer to Lead or Speak
volunteer.intro: POWER members can volunteer to lead the prayer or to deliver a message on a particular day of the week. Fill out the form below and someone will follow up with you.
volunteer.nextSteps: We’ll confirm the schedule and share next steps.

topics2026.title: 2026 Topics
topics2026.introBefore: These topics were prayerfully inspired by God and entrusted to our staff for 2026. Tap any date to jump to that week. If you would like to lead the prayer line or deliver a message, please
topics2026.noTopic: No topic found for this week.
topics2026.note: Note: these topics may change at the staff's discretion.

creed.title: Our Creed
creed.introBefore: We are a non-denominational ministry, united around the following key tenets of the Christian faith. Help us spread the word by sharing
creed.introAfter: on social media, or with family and friends.

reunion.title: 2026 POWER Reunion
reunion.intro: Complete the registration form below and submit your payment to reserve your spot.

paypal.line1: We use PayPal as our payment gateway. However, you do not need a PayPal account to pay the registration fee.
paypal.line2: If you don’t have a PayPal account, choose Pay with Debit or Credit Card during checkout.
paypal.imageAlt: Pay with debit or credit card option

whoFor.title: Who this is for
whoFor.body: Complete one registration per attendee, or increase the quantity if you are paying for multiple people.

confirmation.title: Confirmation
confirmation.body: Be sure to use an email address you actively check so you can receive updates and payment confirmation.

phone.title: Phone number
phone.body: Adding your phone number is optional, but helpful in case the team needs to contact you quickly.
